job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: The Analyst will support efforts to improve the use of criminal justice, human services, and other administrative data by transforming data into routine reports, dashboards, and geospatial analytics that inform MONSE’s and partner agencies’ planning and operations
This role requires a unique combination of technical expertise and experience in government or public service
This role is critical to ensuring that those who live, work, and play in Baltimore have transparent access to data on MONSE’s strategic commitments

The position requires strong alignment with the City of Baltimore's and MONSE's mission, values, and strategic vision, as well as demonstrated success, sound judgment, and flexibility working in a complex, fast-paced environment
The successful candidate will deliver timely, accurate, and relevant data analysis for at least two of MONSE’s focus areas

Essential Functions Reporting, Grant Compliance, and Dashboard Management Grant Reporting: Prepare and deliver accurate data for quarterly grant reports in partnership with program managers and agency leadership, ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local funding requirements
Meet regularly with program managers to ensure timely and accurate data submissions from portfolio of grantees
Ad-Hoc Requests: Respond to one-off and recurring data requests from internal leadership, city agencies, and the public, providing timely and accurate statistical summaries

Dashboard and Geospatial Design: Design, develop, and maintain a suite of regular dashboards and reports using tools like Power BI and geospatial representations with ArcGIS or similar software tailored for various audiences
Data System Management: Supports the routine maintenance and development of MONSE’s data system
This includes but is not limited to: creating/editing tables, building reports and data views, and setting up form-relationships
Quality Assurance: Ensure all reporting products are accurate, user-friendly, and visually compelling, requiring an exceptional level of attention to detail and patience

Visualization: Translate complex programmatic activities and policy considerations into clear data visualizations, including maps and dashboards, that track progress and highlight key trends for senior leadership
Program Evaluation and Performance Monitoring Support the design and implementation of evaluation frameworks for MONSE initiatives
Partner with program staff to co-develop relevant and insightful performance indicators for effective program monitoring
Conduct baseline data analyses to establish benchmarks for measuring program effectiveness and impact over time
Advise on data collection strategies and best practices to ensure the quality and integrity of data used for evaluation

jobs_results.description:
Financial Data Analyst is a remote review track for evaluating AI outputs across finance and risk workflows. Reviewers grade calculations, narrative reasoning, and policy adherence; flag compliance and reconciliation issues; and document the correct treatment so the modeling team can train on it.


  Why this role matters
 Finance and risk workflows leave no room for fuzzy reasoning. AuraOne uses experienced finance-and-risk professionals to grade AI outputs the way an audit reviewer would — with citations, severity tags, and the corrected calculation alongside the original.


  Responsibilities
 
  Review AI outputs against current finance and risk standards, regulations, and firm policy for Financial Data Analyst assignments.
  Re-perform calculations and flag rounding, classification, or treatment errors.
  Tag compliance, reconciliation, and disclosure issues with structured severity scores.
  Capture the corrected workpaper or narrative so the modeling team can train on it.
  Adjudicate disputed treatments against published standards or firm guidance.
  Maintain reviewer-quality scores in inter-rater calibration cycles.
 
  Qualifications
 
  Direct working experience with finance and risk on real engagements, transactions, or audits for Financial Data Analyst work.
  A CPA, CFA, or ACA. A comparable credential or equivalent applied experience also works.
  Comfort applying multi-page rubrics consistently across long batches.
  Clear written reasoning that cites standards, regulations, or firm policy.
  Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week.
 
  Example tasks
 
  Re-perform a finance and risk calculation produced by a model and flag any rounding or classification errors.
  Grade a model's narrative reasoning on a complex transaction and rate the citation quality.
  Adjudicate a disputed treatment between two reviewers using current standards.
  Audit a 25-row batch for rubric consistency and report drift to the program lead.
 
  Nice to have
 
  Big Four, bulge-bracket, or in-house controller / risk experience.
  Familiarity with AI-assisted close, audit, or risk tooling and its failure modes.
  Bilingual experience for cross-jurisdiction reviews.
 
  Skills
 
  Financial analysis
  Audit-grade review
  Regulatory standards
  Risk assessment
  Finance and risk
  analytical thinking
  attention to detail
  cross-functional collaboration
  data cleaning
  data documentation
  data organization
  data transformation
 
  Work model
 Remote — US-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US.


  Compensation
 $60–$120 / hr

 Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs_results.description:
Virta Health is on a mission to transform type 2 diabetes and weight-loss care. Current treatment approaches aren't working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives.

The Product Analytics team harnesses data to shape decisions across Virta. In this role you'll sit on Product Analytics and partner closely with our Client Group, turning messy, cross-system billing data into accurate, trustworthy answers that keep our client relationships running smoothly.

Role OverviewAs a Data Analyst supporting the Client Group, you'll own the data work behind accurate, reliable client billing. You'll start with a focused mandate: reconciling billing data across internal systems, investigating and resolving discrepancies, and building the checks and documentation that make billing accuracy repeatable and durable. As that foundation takes hold, your scope will grow into ongoing work reducing client billing friction—streamlining processes, improving data flows, and proactively surfacing issues before they reach a client. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who is energized by getting numbers to tie out and by making a genuinely complex data landscape simpler.

ResponsibilitiesReconcile and validate client billing data across multiple internal systems, investigating and resolving discrepancies to ensure accuracy and integrity.

Build repeatable data-quality checks, reconciliations, and documentation that strengthen billing processes and controls.

Partner directly with the Client Group to support timely, accurate client billing and to answer their most pressing data questions.

Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and analyses that surface billing trends, risks, and anomalies.

Over time, drive down client billing friction through process improvement, better data flows, and automation.

Collaborate across Product Analytics, the Client Group, Finance, and Engineering to understand data sources and improve the systems that feed billing.

Operate within an agile framework, prioritizing effectively as needs and priorities shift.

Must-Haves5+ years of experience in an analytics, data, or finance-operations role.

Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, large-dataset manipulation, reconciliation).

Strong SQL skills and comfort working with relational databases.

Demonstrated experience reconciling data across systems and investigating and resolving discrepancies.

Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data accuracy.

Ability to navigate imperfect data and adjust to a dynamic environment with shifting priorities.

Clear communicator who can work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-HavesExperience with healthcare data (medical or pharmacy claims, accounts receivable).

Familiarity with billing, revenue operations, or accounts-receivable processes.

Experience building reporting or dashboards in a BI tool such as Looker or Tableau.

Exposure to Google BigQuery, dbt, or similar data-warehouse tooling.

Python or scripting experience (a plus, not a requirement).

Understanding of data governance, data-quality frameworks, or internal controls.

Values-driven cultureVirta's company values drive our culture, so you'll do well if:

You put people first and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally

You have a strong sense of ownership and take initiative while empowering others to do the same

You prioritize positive impact over busy work

You have no ego and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience

You appreciate transparency and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information

You are evidence-based and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma

You take risks and rapidly iterate

Standardized processes to improve scalability, capacity, reliability, and control effectiveness

Prepare technical documentation for regulatory reporting processes, automated workflows, data pipelines, and analytical models
